## Transport Poverty Sandpit

A sandpit workshop hosted at Cloth Hall Court, Leeds, bringing together DfT, ITS Leeds, and the European Commission's Joint Research Centre (Transport Poverty Hub) to advance work on transport poverty definitions, measurement methodologies, and data requirements.
